metadata.case_name: CHONG CHI CHING v. SECRETARY FOR JUSTICE (FOR AND ON BEHALF OF THE GOVERNMENT OF THE HKSAR) AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: customer service officer (employed by the HKSAR Government on a non-civil servant contract, working at the Governments integrated call centre "1823")

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of back with prolapsed intervertebral disc L4/5
source: Both orthopaedic experts agreed that P suffered from soft tissue injury of back with prolapsed intervertebral disc L4/5
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: adjustment disorder with depressed mood / depressive disorder
source: Both doctors agreed about the diagnosis of P being adjustment disorder with depressed mood; the adjustment disorder was mainly caused by the accident and is consistent with the injury
According to the medical report prepared by Dr Sham Kwan Ho of the Department of Psychiatry dated 20 May 2013, P was diagnosed to have depressive disorder.

manifestations.description: bilateral hip flexion and knee extension power limited by back pain
decrease in power of both lower limbs, more marked on right side
sensational loss in bilateral lower limbs
chronic low back pain and stiffness
intermittent drop-foot / sudden numbness and weakness of right leg
reduced mobility requiring walking stick, frame or wheelchair at times
low mood, irritability, poor concentration, poor sleep and social withdrawal

treatments_received: A&E attendance and analgesics on 24 December 2009
physiotherapy (UCH) from 2 March 2010 to 21 June 2011 (9 sessions) and additional sessions in 2011
bonesetter treatment (plaster) by Lai Sing Wah on 5 March 2010
epidural steroid injection 2 attempted (17 September 2013) but suspended
psychiatric treatment (18 sessions) in psychiatric department of UCH between 2 March 2012 and 8 January 2013
treatments_future: psychiatric follow-up (public sector) for at least 2 years (opinion of Dr Ho)
psychiatric follow-up (shorter course) per Dr Law

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenity (PSLA) awarded

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Loss of supermarket cash coupons (award HK$2,000)

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks

losses.description: Travelling expenses to medical consultations (award HK$7,614)

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink

losses.description: Other special damages - walking stick (award HK$450)
